# Baseline for internal/conformance's TestCorpusMatchesBaseline.
#
# One "path outcome # reason" line per vendored sv-tests file whose observed
# outcome differs from what its own metadata expects: a file with
# :should_fail_because: must produce a diagnostic, any other must not.
# "outcome" is what the pipeline does TODAY (pass = no diagnostics, fail =
# at least one), so the expectation is always the opposite. Any file not
# listed here is expected to match its metadata, and a listed file that now
# matches fails the test as stale.
#
# Updating this file is a deliberate act: a new entry needs a real reason, and
# a removed entry means a genuine fix landed (with its own tests). Never
# regenerate it wholesale. The stages run are capped by
# conformance.MaxImplemented, so raising that cap legitimately adds
# "undetected" entries only for files whose failure shows up in the newly
# enabled stage; fix or explain each one.

# --- Negative tests whose error needs a semantic or lint rule that is not implemented yet (61) ---

chapter-16/16.10--property-local-var-fail.sv pass # undetected: pipeline increments value by 4 but property expects incrementation by 3
chapter-16/16.10--sequence-local-var-fail.sv pass # undetected: pipeline increments value by 4 but sequence expects incrementation by 3
chapter-16/16.15--property-disable-iff-fail.sv pass # undetected: disable iff uses wrong reset polarity
chapter-5/5.10-structure-arrays-illegal.sv pass # undetected: C-like assignment is illegal
chapter-7/arrays/packed/variable-slice-zero.sv pass # undetected: slicing array with zero part width
chapter-8/8.25.1--parametrized_class_invalid_scope_resolution.sv pass # undetected: parametrized class invalid scope resolution
chapter-8/8.26.3--type_access_implements_invalid.sv pass # undetected: typedefs are not inherited by implements operator
chapter-8/8.26.4--illegal_implements_parameter.sv pass # undetected: implementing parameter that resolves to an interface class is not allowed
chapter-8/8.26.6.1--name_conflict_unresolved.sv pass # undetected: unresolved interface class method name conflict
chapter-8/8.26.6.2--parameter_type_conflict_unresolved.sv pass # undetected: superclass type declaration conflicts must be resolved in subclass
